commandDescriptions.dataset-ndjson: Retain JSON Lines sources, map fields, build and query datasets, and open the source console.
commandDescriptions.dataset-ndjson-merchant: Prepare, inspect and serve NDJSON merchants, and package their dataset releases.
commandDescriptions.dataset-ndjson-customer: Receive acquired NDJSON releases or delivery rooms and restore their reviewed source edition.
commandDescriptions.dataset-ndjson-job: Receive a complete file preparation job, reconstruct its original datasets, and resume interrupted delivery.
commandDescriptions.source-monitoring: Receive original OpenSanctions data, review complete updates and native screening, and carry the customer source and case history to another installation.
